art_direction: 成年春丽穿天蓝色不透光运动背心与宽松白色短裤，在海边木栈道一边抬手调整发髻丝带、一边轻快跨步，神情自信，整体清爽有活力。
composition_variation: Illustrate adult Chun-Li in an original peaceful ocean-boardwalk moment, with recognizable brown eyes, dark hair in two buns, small white ribbons, and an assured friendly smile. She walks forward after a relaxed morning jog, lifting one arm to adjust a bun ribbon while her other hand holds a small reusable water bottle close to her waist. Outfit her in an opaque sky-blue sleeveless athletic shirt with a standard crew neckline, loose white running shorts, and clean trainers. Her fit adult proportions and strong posture are natural, with no erotic framing or combat stance. Breezes ripple the ribbons against soft ocean waves and pale wooden railings. Use crisp sophisticated anime lines, clean cel shading, and sunny cyan-white color harmony. Leave the top quarter uncluttered; keep her face around forty-five percent height and both hands within the central safe region.
